value.rationale: An entire nonisotrivial one-parameter family of genus-four double covers has uniformly superspecial two-dimensional Pryms even though the ambient genus-four Jacobian is generally neither ordinary nor superspecial and the genus-two quotient is ordinary. This identifies a meaningful low-characteristic Prym moduli phenomenon, distinguishing a maximal a-number invariant not determined by existing ambient p-rank statements. The exact invariant is naturally motivated by the involution and Prym construction.
